subject: Customer site closure: comms plan, action sweep & owner confirmations
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Park <sarah.park@acmecorp.com>, procurement@acmecorp.com
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 01 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Customer site closure: initial notes & ownership ask

Hi Sarah — great to meet the team in-person last week. Thanks for the productive sessions and the time you all put into the integration review.

Attached is a compact summary of the onsite outcomes and an initial action sweep (columns: owner, due date, status, dependencies). This is V1 and meant to get owners confirmed quickly so we can kick off the tracked work.

High level asks for you and the Acme team:
- Please confirm a primary owner for each Acme action noted in the first tab of the spreadsheet.
- Flag any items that require legal/ procurement engagement (I copied procurement to help).
- If you want a different cadence for handoff (weekly vs. biweekly), reply with preference.

I’ve kept internal owners tentative where we discussed follow-up (Ben for billing/pricing, Monica for deliverables & SOW updates). We’ll take feedback and publish a finalized action matrix by EOD Wednesday.

Attachments: [acme-action-matrix-v1.xlsx (xlsx, 34KB)], [redwood-postsite-summary.pdf (pdf, 120KB)]

Thanks —
Priyom
Priyom Das | Account Lead, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
p: +1 415-555-0123 | pri...@redwoodinference.com

From: Sarah Park <sarah.park@acmecorp.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@acmecorp.com
Date: Mon, 01 Mar 2027 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Customer site closure: initial notes & ownership ask

Thanks Priyom — nice to meet you in person as well. The team appreciated the demo and the performance notes.

Quick replies: 
- I’ll own the integration acceptance criteria and will assign a primary contact for each technical action by EOD Tuesday (my note: will confirm exact names).
- Procurement: we’ll need the finalized pricing appendix and a sample invoice to move through our internal PO process. Procurement, looping you in — can you confirm what you need from Redwood to start a PO?

Two small asks from Acme: 
1) Can you include a short (1-page) summary for execs that strips technical detail and lists outcomes + ROI estimates? That helps our CFO front-load approval.
2) We’d like weekly status emails for the first month, then move to biweekly.

If you can update the action matrix with the exec summary link and cadence column, that’ll be ideal.

—Sarah
Sarah Park | Head of Data Integrations, Acme Corp

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Park <sarah.park@acmecorp.com>, procurement@acmecorp.com
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 01 Mar 2027 16:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Customer site closure: initial notes & ownership ask

Thanks Sarah — noted and thanks procurement for being on the thread.

I uploaded two items: the action matrix (now with tentative names in the "owner" column) and a one-page exec summary in the Drive link below. I also added a cadence column and set weekly updates for the first 30 days.

I attached the updated spreadsheet here for quick reference as well. Action highlights (owners in parentheses):
- Integration acceptance sign-off (Sarah) — ACME
- Production data retention / audit log ask (Rishi) — Redwood to produce sample log export by Mar 8
- Billing appendix: sample invoice & pricing schedule (Ben) — Redwood to provide by Mar 4

Attachments: [acme-action-matrix-v1.xlsx (updated) (xlsx, 36KB)]
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cAcmePostSite

Next steps: I’ll convert the V1 into a tracked JIRA board (INF-9483) by Tuesday morning and assign tickets to the owners above. Monica, can you take point on the finalized delivery timeline and SOW edits?

Thanks —
Priyom

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, Sarah Park <sarah.park@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 02 Mar 2027 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Customer site closure: initial notes & ownership ask

Looping in procurement@redwoodinference.com for a sample invoice and the billing appendix template. Sarah / Acme procurement — to move through Acme PO we typically need:
- Pricing appendix (line items + renewal terms)
- Estimated first invoice amount and typical invoicing cadence
- Contact for billing questions (Ben Carter, ben.carter@redwoodinference.com)

I’ve attached a standard billing appendix template and a mock invoice showing first-month charges. If there are specific fields your AP team requires, send an example and we’ll adapt.

Attachments: [redwood-billing-appendix-template.docx (docx, 18KB)], [mock-invoice-acme.pdf (pdf, 7KB)]

Ben
Ben Carter | Director, Revenue Operations

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Sarah Park <sarah.park@acmecorp.com>
Date: Wed, 03 Mar 2027 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Customer site closure: comms plan, action sweep & owner confirmations

All — I reviewed the action matrix and made the following updates:
- Added firm delivery dates for the three milestone deliverables (internal review complete by Mar 15; pilot live by Apr 1; full rollout planning by Apr 15).
- Created a shared SOW draft and placed it in Drive (link below). Please review the SOW draft and comment by Friday EOD — I’ll incorporate changes and hand off to legal for redlines.
- I’ll own weekly status emails (template in Drive) for the first month and will publish the first status update next Monday.

Drive (SOW + templates): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cAcmePostSite
JIRA board: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-9483

If procurement needs anything else for the PO, Ben — please coordinate directly with procurement@acmecorp.com and copy me.

Thanks —
Monica
Monica Patel | Delivery Manager, Redwood Inference
